_note: Codex reports tokens, not dollars, so the scorecard prices them from this table. Rates are USD per million tokens, OpenAI standard tier, short context (<=272K input tokens), read from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing on the date below; `cached` is the cached-input rate (Codex's input_tokens already includes the cached part). Matching is by the longest model prefix. Long-context requests cost more (gpt-6.1-sol 4/0.20/15, gpt-6.1-terra 2/0.10/7.50, gpt-5.5 10/1/45) and are not priced here.
